segments.text: When on the contrary, those yogis, or that yogi, who cannot hold the Turyasa in the state
of Jagrath, Sopun and Sushafthi, as is already explained in previous sutra, Prana-Samaacharya
Samadarshanam. He cannot do in such, he cannot obtain that state properly.
Apeethu purvapara-koti samvajit, Turya-chamatkara-mathreva-santrashanasthi, on the contrary, who remains
then becomes satisfied in that Turya-rasa, which is held or experienced in the entry and
in the exit state only. In the entry and exit, in going in Jagrathivaya, going in
the happiness or coming out from the happiness or going in the dreaming state or coming out
from the dreaming state or going in the dreamless state or coming out from the dreamless state,
there he finds the state of Turya. But not in the center of weakness, not in the center of
the dreaming state, not in the center of the dreamless state. He does not find that Turya-rasa.
The one who is like that, Tadashya, Madhya, Avara Prasava. Then for him, it is said that in the center,
in the central field of all these three states, Avara Prasava. He does not experience God consciousness,
the state of God consciousness. The state of God consciousness, he experiences only in the beginning and
in the end of these three states, Jagrath, Sopana and Sushvati. Purva-apara-kottu, Turya-rasa-rasa-daya-daya,
the one who experiences and enjoys the nectar of Supreme God consciousness, in Purukoti and apara-kotti.
Purukoti means in the beginning, apara-kotti means in the end of these three states. Madhya-masyadashya,
in the center, what happens to him? Avara, Avara Prasava. He floods, he flows out in not a
Supreme way, in a Supreme manner. That is, Vitha-Rathma Kuchita Sargojayate. He experiences just as we do
in wakefulness. He experiences in dreaming state just as we do. He experiences in dreaming state and
dreamless state as we do. He is as good as ourselves. Only he is good in the beginning and in the end,
in the beginning and in the end, he is filled with God consciousness, but in the center, he is just like us.
But you must not go to this point that he is aware from God consciousness.
He has held God consciousness in the beginning and in the end, but he is unable. He is not capable of
holding God consciousness in the center of these three states.
Moha, illusion, or for all ways, only in the center, in the center of these three states.
It is said in Malini Vijayatantara also.
Vasana Matrila-Bepi, Yo Pramato Najayate, Tamaniteshu-Bhogeeshu, Yoji and Tivyanayaka,
Tasmati Nateshu-Samsaktim-Kurvi-to-Tamavan-Jaya. It is, it is Vasana Matrila-B that makes him,
makes him stable in that point, makes him stop. He is stopped. His flow is held in the center.
His flow of God consciousness is held, blocked. That flow of God consciousness is no more in the center
of these three states because of Vasana Matrila, because he has Vasana. Vasana means he has impressions,
traces of what people are talking of myself, what people should expect from me,
what people should get help from me. He wants to help people. He wants to make them satisfied
with giving boons. It is why he is held in the center. If he has no such thought,
then his God consciousness is flowed throughout in the beginning, in the end and in the center.
It is said, Vasana Matrila-Bepi-yo-apramat-to-Najayati,
Devon, who does not become apramata, who does not become apramata, who does not become apramata means,
who does not lose temper, lose temper of that one being, whose temper is lost,
whose temper is lost by people, by giving boons to people whose temper is lost.
He should not feel about the people. In which way, you should not feel about the people.
He should not feel anything except God. There is no distress. There is no distress. There is no distress
there. Distress does not arise there. Tam anitya-subha-ghe-shu, then the one who feels like that,
tam anitya-subha-ghe-shu-yo-jinthi, he becomes and he becomes, he becomes, he is played by
hunger, he is played by thirst, he is played by everything, every worst thing of this life,
daily routine of life. So he is played by this universe, in the center. Although he is aware of God
consciousness in the beginning and in the end. Tasmat-nate-susam-saktim-kurvi-to-devan,
who desires for the highest being, for the achievement of highest being, uttama-vanjaya,
the one who is desires of achieving the highest being. He should not be attached to these outward
things for people. With prahapisam-vajitam, this is already explained in previous sutras.
I think we will do this much. But as it is explained in the Third Awakening Anvapaya,
so you have to begin. You have to see that he is also not away from Shambhapaya. He is carried to
that spot. The aspirant of Anvapaya, the aspirant of Shakthapaya, all these two are carried to Shambhapaya,
and Shambhapaya was stayed in the end. There is no difference in the end for all these three.
